objective: Implement a demo feature by updating independent documentation and CLI fixture outputs.
constraints: one Execution Group per independent subtask
Test feedback must be processed whether pass or fail
success_criteria: all independent group changes appear in the integration candidate
simulated Test failure maps to original group and is reworked
simulated Test success releases active groups but preserves responsibility records

evidence.relevance: demo request defines deterministic execution closure

candidate_plans.claim: Use the direct split-integrate-test-feedback execution plan.
candidate_plans.why: Only one contract-valid plan remains after dominated alternatives are removed.
weaknesses: demo uses filesystem workspaces instead of production git branches
candidate_plans.risk_if_wrong: Runtime may look complete while production branch governance remains future work.

candidate_plans.claim: Let one worker directly edit all files without group split.
candidate_plans.why: This is simpler but loses group ownership.
candidate_plans.risk_if_wrong: Failures cannot be mapped to a responsible group.

subtasks.input_contract: documentation contract is local to docs/feature_overview.md
subtasks.output_contract: document explains the demo feature objective
subtasks.independence_reason: The overview document has no dependency on the CLI fixture output.
